authorization: Undergo diagnostics before adding new changes. commit and push stage4 to github

diagnostic_design.pose: Image-only connector/pin cue labels all1101 train/cal/test normals and anomalies before outcome joins. Record priorStage4 knowledge; no causal/doubleblind claim. Categorical only if validated.
diagnostic_design.missing_query: All GT-overlap frozen-grid cells and one-cell context ring,top5 unrestricted frozen-memory nearest neighbors; maskunion for multitype images.
diagnostic_design.spatial_units: Euclidean normalized crop-coordinate displacement divided by sqrt2; descriptive radii no tuning
diagnostic_design.board_grid: 4x4 normalized crop,not semantic board segmentation; account padding/excludedpixels separately
diagnostic_design.statistics: Descriptive image-level associations and sample sizes; no significance or causal gate
diagnostic_design.small_defects: Fixed PCB1R1/R2, operational saved-score categories; retain mixed cases and paired D2rescue without representation-cause proof
diagnostic_design.recommendation: Exactly one controlled Stage5B proposal supported by diagnostics; do not execute
